payload.title: Reconcile five-student audit and typed cloud read instructions
payload.objective: Preserve scoped academic evidence, typed instruction topology, full authorized academy branch archive and a Sites/Space-independent read-only private viewer; review and publish only scoped changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate source observations, scoped teacher review and physical paper states
Preserve unknown book editions and historical book transitions
Validate instruction graph and normal read-route fallbacks
Verify private data integrity and scope without claiming exhaustive source truth
Review and publish without inventing CI/native acceptance
Portable viewer reuses existing dataset/domain boundaries and rejects public binding
Full authorized academy branch archive restores with matching hashes; unrelated domains excluded
